newsitem.title: LATVIA: PAREKSS PLACES ODESSA MUNICIPAL BONDS-REPORT.
newsitem.headline: PAREKSS PLACES ODESSA MUNICIPAL BONDS-REPORT.

text.p: Parekss Bank, the biggest bank in Latvia, has placed one-year municipal bonds issued by the Ukrainian city of Odessa, worth around 30 million hryvnias ($17 million), the Diena bizness newspaper reported on Friday.
"The paper has a coupon of 50 percent and nominal values range betwen 10 to 1,000 hryvnias," Jevgenii Luksep, the bank's manager of investment and securities, is reported as saying by the newspaper.
The bonds will finance Odessa's infrastructure development and are secured by city property and revenue. They will be placed outside Ukraine, the newspaper writes.
"Almost all of the issue has already been sold to Parekss bank's clients and partners," Luksep says in the interview.
The depository services are provided by the Bank of New York, the paper said.
